name: Spinal Arachnoiditis
definition: Chronic inflammatory and fibrotic disorder involving spinal arachnoid membranes and nerve roots, sometimes following surgery, infection, hemorrhage or intrathecal insult.

investigations.principle: MRI may show nerve-root clumping, empty-sac appearance or adhesions; imaging findings require clinical correlation.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, inflammatory, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Surgery has limited and variable benefit; repeated invasive procedures should be approached cautiously.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Vata-neuropathic phenotype may be documented only as a parallel framework.

patientEducation.summary: Chronic inflammatory and fibrotic disorder involving spinal arachnoid membranes and nerve roots, sometimes following surgery, infection, hemorrhage or intrathecal insult.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
